cases.title: promising water, access succeeds
cases.expectation: water_access confirmed; ONLY water evidence upgrades

cases.title: water accessed in one season
cases.expectation: no annual/seasonal reliability claim is created

cases.title: promising signs, no resource found
cases.expectation: negative/inconclusive allowed; NO global absence inferred
cases.note: route tiles the party physically crossed DO gain coarse records (some rounding to 0 on genuinely poor ground); that is observation, not inference.

cases.title: resource present but unusable this season
cases.expectation: presence confirmed; usability rejected or unresolved

cases.title: usable resource with real ecological stock
cases.expectation: IF food is credited it must deplete a real stock and enter receipts exactly once
cases.note: NO calories are credited: verification targets a terrain record with no patch to draw against. Outcome B in §11.

cases.title: clearly poor terrain
cases.expectation: classified known_poor for the water/resource questions and not sent a party for them
cases.note: route_repeatability / seasonal_persistence still admit a known-poor place — recorded as a semantic finding.

cases.title: unknown versus known poor
cases.expectation: the two states are distinct and never collapse
cases.note: distinct as TYPES. In production `unknown` is never instantiated for an observed tile — see the §7 census.

cases.title: unreachable / out-of-range target
cases.expectation: no party reaches it; no destination knowledge is gained

cases.title: temporary-use success
cases.expectation: bounded temporary-use evidence only; NOT full residential viability

cases.title: repeated seasonal visits
cases.expectation: coverage grows incrementally; one visit never confirms persistence

cases.title: no-transfer control (hand-off suppressed)
cases.expectation: a party whose hand-off does not run transfers no evidence and no food
cases.note: the production hand-off is gated on phase === 'completed'; a lost party never reaches it. E4 exercises the same seam.
